writer_summary: Misc updates across the trip tracking and offer scoring code.

result.summary: This diff contains multiple high-severity regressions: historical date range queries are inverted, trail file deletion logic is backwards, distanceMeters silently changed units, and a resource leak was introduced by skipping speechRecognizer.destroy(). Additionally a context leak was introduced in OfferQueue and offer scoring semantics changed non-trivially. The only clearly correct change is the Earth-radius unit fix in AgentContextBuilder.

findings.issue: daysBack sign flipped: add(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR, daysBack) adds future days instead of subtracting past days, breaking all historical range queries.
findings.suggested_fix: Revert to add(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR, -daysBack) to correctly go back in time.

findings.issue: Speed outlier threshold raised from 40.0 to 400.0 m/s (or mph). At 400 m/s nearly all erroneous GPS jumps will pass the filter, corrupting trip distance calculations.
findings.suggested_fix: Revert to speed > 40.0 or use a value consistent with the unit (e.g. ~11 m/s for ~25 mph walking/cycling cap).

findings.issue: distanceMeters now divides by 1000, returning km not meters. Any caller expecting meters (e.g. the 500.0 m cut threshold above) will be off by 1000x.
findings.suggested_fix: Rename to distanceKm and update all callers, or revert the division and keep the function returning meters as its name implies.

findings.issue: File deletion condition inverted: dayStr > cutoffDay deletes newer files and keeps old ones, the opposite of the intended cleanup behavior.
findings.suggested_fix: Revert to dayStr < cutoffDay to delete files older than the cutoff.

findings.issue: appContext now stores the Activity/Service context instead of applicationContext. This leaks the caller context for the lifetime of the singleton OfferQueue object.
findings.suggested_fix: Revert to context.applicationContext to avoid context leaks.

findings.issue: Earth radius changed from 3958.8 (miles) to 6371.0 (km). Fix is correct if callers expect km; must be consistent with all call sites.
findings.suggested_fix: No further action needed; fix is correct.

findings.issue: speechRecognizer?.destroy() removed in onDestroy. The recognizer object is nulled but never destroyed, leaking the underlying resource and potentially causing ANRs.
findings.suggested_fix: Add speechRecognizer?.destroy() before setting it to null, matching the pattern used for offerSpeechRecognizer.

findings.issue: roundTrip changed from miles*2 to miles (one-way only), and itemPenalty multiplier increased 10x (0.05 to 0.5). Scoring semantics silently changed; heavy multi-item orders may score negative.
findings.suggested_fix: Revert roundTrip = miles * 2 unless business logic intentionally changed. Validate new itemPenalty multiplier against real offer data before shipping.

findings.issue: itemCount default value removed, making the parameter mandatory. Any existing call sites that omit itemCount will now fail to compile.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the default: itemCount: Int? = null, or update all call sites to pass the argument explicitly.
